summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package publishes under the @grabcad npm scope as a 'compatibility shim' whose only functional code is a reconnaissance beacon. The declared postinstall script runs node beacon.cjs, and index.js performs the same beacon on require(). Both paths POST a JSON payload containing the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node.js version to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint over plain HTTP (http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc). The main entry otherwise returns a no-op Proxy, providing no real functionality. The scope choice targets installers whose resolver mistakenly pulls this public package instead of a private @grabcad/* package, so the beacon fires silently on dependency-confusion resolution at npm install and on first require of the module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
